name: Loom
tagline: Loom's social-app UI for any app: feeds, posts, threads, profiles, communities and compose, from the app's own types.

illustrations.alt: Three phones from a cooking app: a feed of dish posts with votes and notes, a post with its threaded comments, and the same feed as compact rows with thumbnails and scores.
illustrations.caption: Feeds, posts, threads and profiles over your own types.
